message: Exclusive Insider Syndicate: Our AI arbitrage bot guarantees 25% weekly profit with 100% principal protection. Over 1,200 investors joined this month. Minimum deposit: $250. Withdraw anytime with zero lock-in period.
explanation: No financial market investment can ever guarantee 25% weekly returns with zero risk. This is a classic Ponzi scheme / Pig Butchering syndicate.

choices.text: Identify as Investment Ponzi; report and ignore the solicitation
choices.feedback: Masterful awareness! Any promise of guaranteed returns with no risk is fundamentally fraudulent.

choices.text: Deposit minimum $250 to see if the first withdrawal actually works
choices.feedback: Trap! They often allow the first $20 withdrawal to build false confidence, baiting you into depositing $5,000.

choices.text: Ask for the company registration certificate to verify legality
choices.feedback: Fraudsters routinely present forged UK/Dubai shell company certificates.
